scope: Standing Bourguiba Mausoleum in Monastir, with the central gold dome, two green cupolas, the white marble towers, side terraces and arcades, and the ornamental entrance fence.

originalReview.notes: Front exterior establishes the paired octagonal towers and open upper galleries, gold ribbed dome, green cupolas, courtyard arcades, and wrought iron screen with gilt medallions.

quallaSearch.notes: The exact published exterior was found first in Qualla and verified against Runtinger’s original upload and first signed own-work CC0 declaration.
